title: Lonnie Zamora never the same after Socorro

tellings.quote: you know, Sakor, New Mexico. I remember the wife of Lonnie Zamora looking at me and she goes, "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same."

plain: Lonnie Zamora, the man at the centre of a famous 1964 sighting in Socorro, New Mexico, was changed for good by what he saw, according to his wife. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels that she looked at him and said, "I don't know what happened when he looked at that creature, but he was never the same."
